scoreRecommendation.overcast: Stay inside - overcast or very poor conditions.
scoreRecommendation.marginal: Marginal - maybe bright planets through cloud gaps.
scoreRecommendation.partlyCloudy: Partly cloudy - try bright targets like the Moon or planets.
scoreRecommendation.brightMoon: Bright Moon - great for planets, Moon detail, and star clusters. Avoid faint nebulae.
scoreRecommendation.darkSkies: Dark skies - ideal for deep sky: galaxies, nebulae, and faint targets.
scoreRecommendation.excellent: Excellent conditions for any target - deep sky objects, planets, and wide-field.
scoreRecommendation.good: Good for most targets - galaxies and brighter nebulae will show well.
scoreRecommendation.decent: Decent conditions - stick to brighter targets like star clusters and planets.
scoreRecommendation.limited: Limited - try bright planets or the Moon.

supportAsk.title: Enjoying Nebulis?
supportAsk.body1: Nebulis is free, and I intend to keep it that way. I build it in my spare time for people who share my love of the night sky.
supportAsk.body2: My goal is to make Nebulis the best astronomical library and management platform available, giving astrophotographers and astronomy enthusiasts a place to organize, explore, and get the most out of their observations.
supportAsk.body3: If Nebulis has been useful to you, you can support its continued development by buying me a coffee. It helps me dedicate more time to making Nebulis better, and it's always appreciated.
supportAsk.scan: Scan the code with your phone, or use the button below.
supportAsk.qrAlt: QR code for the Buy Me a Coffee page
supportAsk.freeNote: Nebulis will always be free to use. The only exceptions are mobile apps distributed through app stores.
supportAsk.onlyOnce: You'll only see this message once. You can always find it again under Settings → About.
